entries.name: Noble Phantasm
entries.content:
Fake Noble Phantasms: Copies of Noble Phantasms made with Projection Magecraft. Fake Noble Phantasms are a rank below the original and therefor weaker

Noble Phantasms: Magical armaments created from human imagination as their core, and are the weapons and/or abilities owned by Heroic Spirits. As humanity's illusions, they embody the ultimate Mysteries of a hero as symbols of their existence through historical fact and anecdotes.

Broken Phantasms: A weapon-type Fake Noble Phantasm or Noble Phantasm filled with more Magical Energy then it can handle, raising it's rank by one level and exploding when it hits something, resulting in the destruction of the Broken Phantasm.

Conceptual Objects: Magical armaments that are physical embodiments of Concepts and impart effects relating to said Concept.

Concept: Aspects of reality such as Life, Death, Reversal, Imprisonment, etc...

Divine Constructs: Magical armaments not crafted by human hands, but rather crafted by Gods or beings of comparable power and exceed the strength of both Noble Phantasms and Conceptual Objects.

Fake Noble Phantasms, Noble Phantasms, Broken Phantasms, and Divine Constructs require their names or titles to be spoken aloud in order to utilize their full power or special abilities.

Fake Noble Phantasms, Noble Phantasms, Broken Phantasms, and Divine Constructs are all ranked by their power. I order from weakest to strongest, these ranks are: E, E+, E++, E+++, D, D+, D++, D+++, C, C+, C++, C+++, B, B+, B++, B+++, A, A+, A++, A+++, EX, EX+, EX++, and EX+++

entries.name: Heroic Spirit
entries.content:
Also referred to as Servants when they are summoned, Heroic Spirits are the spirits of heroes who achieved great deeds in life, having become objects of reverence or even worship after their deaths. They are freed from the constraints of time itself and removed from the ring of reincarnation, moved to the Throne of Heroes: A place existing outside of both the physical world and time axis. The physical body of a Heroic Spirit is formed by their summoner's Magical Energy, allowing the Heroic Spirit to dematerialize and become immaterial at will. 

Heroic Spirits are placed into one of various Servant Classes. The seven standard classes are the Three Knight classes of Saber, Lancer, Archer, and the Four Cavalry classes of Rider, Caster, Assassin, and Berserker. There is also the non-standard extra Servant Class of Shielder. Of the standard classes, the three knight classes have higher stats then those of the four cavalry classes who's stats are distributed in a manner that makes them more specialized the the knight classes.

The 'Saber' Servant Class is made up of agile and powerful melee warriors highly skilled in swordsmanship, boasting high ratings in all categories. The Saber Class possesses the Magic Resistance and Riding skills.

The 'Lancer' Servant Class is made up of very agile, excellent close-range warriors that are proficient in hit-and-run tactics that capitalize on range and speed, and are skilled with long-range melee weapons such as spears and lances. The Lancer Class possesses the Magic Resistance skill.

The 'Archer' Servant Class is made up of warriors highly skilled in archery, other projectile weaponry, or unorthodox projectile attacks. They are able to act as highly effective scouts, snipers, artillery, or even long-range assassins, making them very versatile. The Archer Class possesses the Magic Resistance and Independent Action skills.

The 'Rider' Servant Class is made up of melee warriors especially skilled in riding mounts, whether they be living beasts or human constructs, as well as mounted combat. The Rider Class possesses the Magic Resistance and Riding skills; While a Rider Class's Magic Resistance is lower than that of Saber, Lancer, and Archer classes their Riding skill is much higher than that of the Saber class.

The 'Caster' Servant Class is made up of highly skilled Mages, and the only qualifying condition is the mastery of sorceries of the highest caliber compared to the specific parameter requirements of the other classes. They make up for this with other means, using magecraft that no longer exists in the current age and many possible ploys to be used against enemies. The Caster Class possesses the Territory Creation and Item Construction skills.

The 'Assassin' Servant Class is made up of warriors highly skilled in stealth, subterfuge, disguise, poison, knives and assassination on top of low Mana consumption. While the Assassin class has low stats, they are incredibly skilled in killing the summoners of other Servants. The Assassin Class possesses the Presence Concealment skill.

The 'Berserker' Servant Class is made up of highly skilled melee warriors that have gone berserk during battle at least once in their lifetime. Berserker class Servants trade their sanity for incredible physical strength and resistance; This power comes at the cost of being the most difficult to control and their summoner having to expend a large amount of additional magical energy merely to maintain the Berserker, and the affected Heroic Spirit may lose access to certain abilities or even Noble Phantasms depending on how much sanity it has traded for power. The Berserker Class possess the Mad Enhancement skill.

The 'Shielder' Servant Class is exclusive to the Heroic Spirit Galahad, a saintly Knight of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s Round Table of Camelot and by extension, Mash Kyrielight's Demi-Servant state. Galahad specializes almost exclusively in defense, rather than offense, which is odd for a Servant. Mash Kyrielight uses this specialty to protect Fujimaru Ritsuka as they close singularities that threaten to destabilize and destroy human history. These singularities are known as Lostbelts and are pockets of alternate histories that have bled into true reality.

Magic Resistance: A skill that grants protection against magical effects.

Riding: A skill that denotes a Heroic Spirit's ability to ride mounts and vehicles.

Independent Action: An ability that allows a Heroic Spirit to stay summoned for a brief time if cut off from their summoner's Magical Energy.

Territory Creation: A skill that allows a Heroic Spirit to build a special terrain that is advantageous to oneself as a magus, such as for the purpose of collecting mana, create magic objects, or perform other tasks. Territories can look different depending on the Servant, as each has their own purpose in mind for the territory they create.

Item Construction: A skill that allows a Heroic Spirit to manufacture magical items, from implements of war to items for daily use. This skill requires gathering components and manufacturing items.

Presence Concealment: A skill that allows a Heroic Spirit to hide their presence, rendering them almost entirely undetectable until the skill is disabled or the user launches an attack.

Mad Enhancement: A skill that raises the stats of a Heroic Spirit's physical abilities at the cost of their sanity.

entries.name: Balmung
entries.content:
Balmung: An 'A+' rank Noble Phantasm belonging to Siegfried, a tragic Dutch hero of German legend. It is a two-handed greatsword adorned with a silver crosses on either side of the shaped metal plate joining the handle and blade, as well as silver inlays on it's crossguard and handle; A magnificent blue jewel is also embedded in the hilt. Balmung is the holy sword of the Nibelung clan used by Siegfried to slay the dragon Fafnir. Upon being bathed in Fafnir's blood along with Siegfried, Balmung took on demonic attributes in addition to it's innate holiness, causing the sword to become either holy or demonic, depending on the wielder's personality. Having accomplished the feat of dragon slaying, Balmung will deal additional damage those with the blood of dragons. 

Feller of the Sky Demon: When the wielder chants "O sword, let thee be filled" and raises it above their head the blue jewel will amass magical energy and channels it into the blade, causing a wave of destructive energy resembling azure flames to surge from the blade when the sword is swung downwards.

entries.name: Projection Magecraft
entries.content: A simple, yet versatile magecraft that shapes Magical Energy into the material composition and design of an object that is being imagined by the caster. While projection can copy Noble Phantasms and Conceptual Objects, the copies are a rank below the original and therefor weaker.

entries.name: Magical Energy
entries.content:
Natural energy found within both the physical world and Magi.

Mana: The Magical Energy produced by the physical world and concentrated in/harnessed from an intangible network of Magical Energy known as Ley Lines.
Od: The Magical Energy produced by all living things. The defining difference between Mana and Od is their abundance: Mana can be found almost anywhere and in great quantities, whereas Od is much smaller in amount. 

Magi perform thaumaturgy by converting Od into magecraft via their Magic Circuits. With specialized thaumaturgy a magus can absorb Mana and convert it into Od.

entries.name: Magic Circuits
entries.content: Magic Circuits are an intangible pseudo-nervous system that spreads itself through the human body and what qualifies a person to be a thaumaturgist. The more Magic Circuits a person has, the more Od they have. The higher quality a Mage's Magic Circuits are, the more powerful their Magecraft is.

entries.name: Thaumaturgists

Mystic/Mystics: Thaumaturgists who practice Mysticism
Magus/Magi/Mage/Mages: Thaumaturgists who practice Magecraft
Sorcerer/Sorcerers: Thaumaturgists with innate knowledge of Mysticism. Sorcerers have either Divine, Demonic, or Fairy blood.

Witch/Witches: Thaumaturgists that practice Witchcraft.

entries.name: Thaumaturgy
entries.content:
Thaumaturgy: The catch-all term for magic usage.
Mysticism: Magic derived directly from Mana rather than Od.
Magecraft: Magic derived from Od rather than directly from Mana.
Sorcery: Mysticism that is innate and does not need to be learned.
Wizardry: Thaumaturgy that amplifies Magecraft through specialized objects; such as wands or staffs.
Witchcraft: A special kind of Mysticism that exclusively utilizes curses, hexes, bewitching, and possession.
Enchanting: Thaumaturgy that imbues objects with Magical Energy for specific uses; such as charms and talismans for protection against thaumaturgy or weapons that harness the elements.
Alchemy: Thaumaturgy that changes or transforms something with Magical Energy; such as transmuting lead into gold or amplifying tonics into potions.

entries.name: Tracing Magecraft
entries.content: A simple, yet versatile magecraft that uses Magical Energy to analyze the shape, substance, material composition and design of an object.

entries.name: Reinforcement Magecraft
entries.content: An incredibly difficult Magecraft with the purpose of pushing a basis to the utmost limit. Success requires a good grasp of the inner structure to fill openings with Magical Energy. Reinforcing the purpose of existence would be increasing the sharpness of a knife, the nourishment of food, or in the case of a living creature, physical strength and durability. It is impossible to reinforce something vague. As living things will resist invasion of Magical Energy, reinforcing someone else is the hardest.

entries.name: Caliburn
entries.content:
Caliburn: A 'B' rank and powerful Noble Phantasm belonging to King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon), the legendary King of Britain. The holy sword that is the symbol of the king pulled from the stone of appointment by King Arthur (Artoria Pendragon) under the guidance of the wizard Merlin. With the words "Whosoe'er pulleth out this sword of this stone is rightwise king of all England" engraved in a golden inscription on its hilt, it became the symbol of England's King of Knights once it was pulled from the stone. It is a dazzling longsword, adorned with much gold.

Golden Sword of the Victorious: When the wielder chants "Sword of Selection, grant me your power. Cleave the wicked. Caliburn." and raises it above their head the sword amasses Magical Energy and channels it into the blade, causing a linear blast of destructive energy resembling golden light to fire from the blade when the sword is swung downwards.

entries.name: Reality Marble
entries.content: A unique kind of Bounded Field that temporarily materializes and projects the user's inner reality onto true reality. The worlds of Reality Marbles are completely cut off from true reality, projecting their internal landscape and sealing off true reality. True reality constantly attempts to crush the unnatural Bounded Fields as they are not created by spiritual beings, meaning that it costs a great deal of Magical Energy to construct one and keep it stabilized. This generally only allows them to be used for a few minutes.

entries.name: Crocea Mors
entries.content:
Crocea Mors: A 'B+' rank and incredibly powerful Noble Phantasm belonging to Gaius Julius Caesar. It is short, golden sword with a cross-shaped hilt and guard, decorated with blue symbols. Said hilt is also blue and possesses a spherical jewel at the bottom.

The Yellow Death: When the wielder chants "I came. I saw. Now I will conquer." Crocea Mors inexplicably ensures victory.

entries.name: Avalon
entries.content: Avalon: An 'EX' rank Noble Phantasm and Conceptual Object and the hallowed scabbard of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s Excalibur. It is a luxurious piece of equipment made of gold and decorated with blue enamel that seems more like a treasure to show dignity and nobility like a crown or staff than a weapon. It was created by fairies along with Excalibur, an unknown phrase is engraved in the language of Fairies on its center to show that it is not the work of man. It bequeaths limited immortality through constant and potent healing, as well as preventing physical deterioration caused by aging.

entries.name: Kanshou & Bakuya
entries.content:
Kanshou & Bakuya: An 'A' rank Noble Phantasm. A pair "married", curved, and single-edged short swords known as the Twin-Linked Crane Wings. These swords were crafted more for the sake of crafting, as if questioning the meaning of the swordsmith, than for any real idea behind their creation. They were created without vanity, and lack a sense of purpose found in other swords. They contain no fighting spirit to defeat others nor a competitive spirit to beat other weapons, and they contain neither the desire to be famous nor the faith to accomplish great deeds. They are identical in shape with the only difference being their color: The blade of Kanshou is matte black and covered in a large, red hexagonal pattern. While the blade of Bakuya has a glossy white finish that reflects light splendidly. These weapons were forged with a human sacrifice, elevating them from simple blades to weapons fit for gods. If one of these swords are thrown while the other is held, the thrown sword will return; spinning like a boomerang. This returning property also applies to Projected copies.

Overedge: A technique that uses reinforcement magic to lengthen and widen the blades of Kanshou and Bakuya.
Triple-Linked Crane Wings: A technique in which the user projects three sets of Kanshou and Bakuya. Beginning with a pair thrown at the enemy with the purpose of being deflected, followed by closing in for close combat with a second pair. While the enemy is off guard, the user slashes with the second pair, and the thrown pair returns and hits the enemy from behind. Finally, the third pair is modified into Overedge and the user performs the final strike with them. The only ways to defeat this technique are with an omni-directional defense, or by ignoring the damage to make a suicidal assault on the user.

entries.name: Enkidu
entries.content: Enkidu: A 'EX' rank Noble Phantasm and Divine Construct belonging to Gilgamesh, a Mesopotamian demigod and first king of humanity. It is an impossible, infinite, and divine chain. Originally belonging to it's eponymous owner and later owned by Gilgamesh. Enkidu has no limit to it's length and an impossible amount of ends. It can be stored within it's wielder's soul, allowing it's bladed ends to manifest and launch from anywhere on the wielder's body. The more divine a target is, the more painful the chain's binding. Neither Enkidu nor it's binding can be broken or loosened by anyone other than the wielder. Enkidu's chains can bind anything, physical or otherwise.

entries.name: Caladbolg II
entries.content:
Caladbolg II: A 'A' rank, modified copy of the Noble Phantasm Caladbolg. It is a spiral sword with a drill-shaped blade modified with Reinforcement Magecraft so it can be be fired from a bow. This Fake Noble Phantasm can only be created with Projection and Reinforcement Magecraft, as it does not technically exist.

Fake Spiral Sword: When the sword's title is spoken the blade of the sword coils into a narrow spiral that travels through anything in it's path by creating a twisting distortion in space until it hits it's target.

entries.name: Hrunting II
secondary_keys: Fake Hound of the Red Plains
entries.content:
Hrunting II: A 'B+++' rank, modified copy of the Noble Phantasm Hrunting. It is a pitch-black spike with a few small edges coiling around the thin core, spiraling around it and somewhat curving outward. It has been modified with Reinforcement Magecraft so it can be be fired from a bow. This Fake Noble Phantasm can only be created with Projection and Reinforcement Magecraft, as it does not technically exist.

Fake Hound of the Red Plains: When sword's title is spoken and fired from a bow, it will autonomously and continuously attempt to hit the target even if it is parried, repulsed, or avoided without losing momentum. Hrunting II will continue it's assault until it hits its target or the weapon is destroyed.

entries.name: Bounded Field
entries.content: A geographical form of Magecraft whereby one knits a boundary line of Magical Energy around a space to separate its inside from the outside, cutting off and isolating that space from the outside world and then imposing an effect on the inside or the boundary line itself.

entries.name: Lord Camelot
secondary_keys: Now is a Castle of Distant Ideals
entries.content:
Lord Camelot: A 'B+++' rank, incredibly powerful and potentially indestructible Noble Phantasm and Conceptual Object belonging to Galahad, a saintly Knight of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s Round Table of Camelot. It is a large, round shield with an additional cross-shaped plate mounted to the face of the shield. The ends of the plate are indented and sharped. It was made from King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s Round Table of Camelot and can potentially become the ultimate defense.

Now is a Castle of Distant Ideals: When the shield's title is spoken a phantasmal recreation of the outer walls of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s castle, Camelot. These phantasmal castle walls protect whoever the wielder of Lord Camelot allows in. The strength and protection of these illusory walls depends on the wielder's willpower.

entries.name: Azrael
entries.content:
Azrael: A 'C' rank, but incredibly powerful Noble Phantasm and Conceptual Object belonging to the first Hassan-i-Sabbah, the first assassin in human history and founder of the Hashashin order of assassins. Azrael is a large, broad-bladed, sword with no crossguard and is seemingly made of blackened iron.

The Angel That Announces Death: Upon the wielder chanting "Hearken. The evening bell tolls thy name. Wings of death, will thou sever their head? Azrael." When the chant is completed and the sword's title is spoken, Azrael causes the target's instantaneous and medically inexplicable death upon touch, even if the blade does not wound them.

entries.name: Unlimited Blade Works
secondary_keys: I am the bone of my sword. Steel is my body and fire is my blood. I have created over a thousand blades. Unknown to Death
Nor known to Life. I have withstood pain to create many weapons. Yet
those hands will never hold anything. So as I pray
entries.content: Unlimited Blade Works: The Noble Phantasm of EMIYA. While it is not a true Noble Phantasm, a Noble Phantasm is defined as a symbol of the Heroic Spirit, then Unlimited Blade Works is EMIYA's Noble Phantasm. It manifests as a hill surrounded by an open, barren desert and monolithic black gears gyrating in the distance. It is a kingdom of rubble littered with thousands, perhaps a countless number, of swords anchored in the ground like grave markers in a wasteland, yet are all well preserved. It is a world likened to a steel mill, filled with weapons, flames, and giant gears. It is the final illusion EMIYA saw on the verge of death, the only pride left within himself. Unlimited Blade Works also acts a database for every weapon EMIYA has ever seen, allowing him to use Projection Magecraft and conjure a Projected copy of any weapon he's seen. Activating Unlimited Blade Works requires EMIYA to chant "I am the bone of my sword. Steel is my body and fire is my blood. I have created over a thousand blades. Unknown to Death, Nor known to Life. I have withstood pain to create many weapons. Yet, those hands will never hold anything. So as I pray, Unlimited Blade Works.". The lines of the incantation can be said at any time without requiring preparation, and EMIYA is able to stop between lines to speak and then resume without issue. The first line is also often used in order to strengthen a Projection. Once the incantations has been completed, an illusionary fire that does not emit any heat spreads out to form a boundary and wall for the Bounded Field. The bright light fills the vision of those present, and EMIYA's inner reality manifests.

entries.name: Gate of Babylon
entries.content: Gate of Babylon: Gate of Babylon is the Noble Phantasm of Gilgamesh. It is the gateway to his treasury, connecting the space of reality to the vault and opening an invisible door between dimensions that allows for the contents to pass through upon their owner's command. The items passing through the gate form gold-glowing energy ripples in the empty air as they appear instantly. Gilgamesh can summon items directly into his hand, pull out weapons from directly behind him, or prepare numerous weapons midair, loaded like bullets. Gilgamesh's treasury contains all the treasures in the world: a perfect treasury that lacks literally nothing. As anything can be found within the vault, the amount of wealth within exceeds even his own knowledge. The most used contents of this treasury are the originals of nearly all weapon-type Noble Phantasms: While these Noble Phantasms are prototypes of the ones that came later, they are no less powerful. Gilgamesh can recall anything brought out of the Gate of Babylon with a thought, the item vanishing into golden particles and returning to his treasury.

entries.name: Time Manipulation Magecraft
entries.content:
Time Manipulation: Magecraft that controls the flow of time. It is the ability to separate the passage of time inside a designated space from the "flow of time" in the outside world. It is a Magecraft in the form of a Bounded Field that can be regarded as a type of Reality Marble in a way, but still not something extraordinarily difficult to utilize like other time related Magecraft. It allows for adjusting time and can only stagnate the time which has passed and accelerate time in the future and cannot reverse cause and effect to change the past.
Time Alteration: A specialized form of Time Manipulation that limits the Bounded Field and it's effect to the user's body. Even this minimalistic approach to Time Manipulation, it is still a Magecraft far above the level of basic physical enchantment that causes inconsistencies between the flow of time inside and outside the field. Once the Time Alteration is complete and the Bounded Field is removed, True Reality will forcefully adjust the incorrect time. This places a large burden on the user with each use, as the Bounded Field where the "errors have occurred" is within their own physical body. In order to get back in sync with the normal time flow, adjustments occur within the user's flesh, greatly damaging them.
Time Alter: Accel is a Time Alteration technique that increases the user's blood flow, hemoglobin metabolism, and muscle movement all at the same time. Using this brief burst of speed, the user can use their own physical skills and reaction speed at a level far above human limitations. It allows for split second evasion in front of an enemy, and its power of mobility can make for one of the greatest defenses.
Time Alter: Stagnate is a Time Alteration technique that slow the user's biological processes by slowing their heartbeat, slowing their breathing, and reducing their metabolism to the point where body temperature cools.

entries.name: Reality
entries.content:
True Reality: The physical world that abides by the laws of nature and the single most powerful force in existence.
Inner Reality: An individual's mental landscape. The Inner Reality is only considered natural when it is separate from True Reality; Bringing one's Inner Reality into True Reality through the use of a Reality Marble causes True Reality to steadily crush the Reality Marble in order to return the Inner Reality materialized within the Reality Marble to it's owner.

entries.name: Ea
secondary_keys: The Star of Creation That Split Heaven and Earth
entries.content:
Ea: An 'EX+' rank, immeasurably powerful Noble Phantasm and Divine Construct possessed only by Gilgamesh, a Mesopotamian demigod and first king of humanity. It has an abnormal shape that doesn't match what would normally be classified as a sword. It is something that was born before the concept of a sword, so it is not something that can truly be called a sword or have the shape of a blade. While it has a grip, handguard, and is the same length as a longsword, the section that should contain a blade deviates from the normal form of an edged weapon. The "blade" itself and the tip of the sword, spun in a spiral shape, are dull. It has the shape of a cylindrical, drill-shaped pillar made up of three independently rotating segments engraved with glowing crimson cuneiform lettering that spin slowly in an alternating direction, the middle segment spinning clockwise and the top and bottom segments spinning counterclockwise. Its three sections respectively represent the heavens, the earth, and the underworld. It exemplifies the world's way of being by having each one of them rotate in opposite directions. The "cosmos" is thus represented by matching all three of these representations. Everything together represents the universe. It is the primordial sword that is the actualization of the works of a god recorded before humanity came into being, and it is that which divided the formless into the distinct heaven, earth and the underworld. When Ea's power is unleashed, it's segments rotate fast enough to draw wind into the sword. This wind is inexplicably compressed and intertwined to become a dislocation of space-time that is represented as something akin to either a torrent or whirlwind. This attack opens an abyss capable of crushing anything. The center of the storm is not calm, but rather a hole to Hell itself that returns all that enters its realm to the nothingness from which it originated. The wind pressure creates a vacuum that takes all things with form, the land, the atmosphere, and the sky, into the whirling void. The tumult of genesis takes everything that was nothing more than chaos, which could not form any meaning, and creates a new truth that divides and distinguishes Heaven, Sea, and Earth. Within the darkness where everything is returned to nothingness, only Ea is left

Ea cannot be copied by Projection Magecraft.

The Star of Creation That Split Heaven and Earth: A technique that releases Ea's maximum output. Depending on the seriousness behind the attack, Ea could potentially destroy all of existence. Activating Ea's full power requires the user to recite one of several incantations: "I will tell you of the beginning: Heaven and Earth split, nothingness congratulated creation, my Sword of Rupture cleaved the world. Mortar of the Stars, Heaven's Hell is the eve of Creation's celebration. Now you shall die and be silent: Enuma Elish.", "Judgment is upon you. Behold the crushing might of my Sword of Rupture: Enuma Elish.", "The elements coalesce and solidify to bring forth the star where creation interweaves. In death, you will bow before it: Enuma Elish.", "I speak of genesis: The elements amalgamate, coalesce, and bring forth the star that weaves all of creation. Pay homage in death: Enuma Elish.", "It is Time. Awaken, Ea. Know the law of Heaven. Worship me and Die: Enuma Elish.", "Ea, Sing praise as you like. I will tell you of the beginning: Heaven and Earth split. Nothingness congratulated Creation... and my Sword of Rupture cleaved the world. Mortar of the Stars, Heaven's Hell is the eve of Creation's celebration: Enuma Elish.". Any of these incantations can be paused and resumed as long as Ea is wielded.

entries.name: Excalibur Galatine (WIP)
entries.content:
Excalibur Galatine: An 'A+' rank, incredibly powerful Noble Phantasm and Divine Construct belonging Gawain, the most loyal and honorable knight of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s Round table. It is the sister sword of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s own Excalibur and is a representation of the sun itself.

Sword of Revolving Victory: A technique in which Excalibur Galatine is thrown high into the air and the pseudo sun within it creates a miniature sun before returning to the wielder's hand. While this pseudo sun floats overhead a large magic circle with a sun symbol in the center appears under the wielder. With a motion like drawing a sword, the wielder unleashes a horizontal slash of flame that pierces through the enemy and erupts into a giant ball of fire that engulfs them. This attack has a range of about 8.1 miles (13 kilometers).

entries.name: Arondight (WIP)
secondary_keys: The Unfading Light of the Lake
entries.content:
Arondight: An 'A' rank and incredibly powerful Noble Phantasm belonging to Lancelot du Lac; One of the greatest knights of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s Round table. It is a holy sword that mirrors and rivals King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s own Excalibur.

Arondight Overload: A technique in which Arondight is glows with the light of the holy light of the Lake from which it, Excalibur and Excalibur Galatine originated. With Arondight overcharged with this holy light the next slash from the sword will leave a glowing gash of said holy light on the target that soon after detonates in a blast of Magical Energy.

Arondight can also launch medium-sized 'waves' of its holy light as projectiles.

entries.name: Black Key
entries.content:
Holy scripture converted into weaponized charms through a holy Magecraft unique to the Holy Church. The base form of a Black Key is a small, crimson, T-shaped charm. When a wielder channels their Magical Energy into a Black Key, they take the form of long and slender rapier-like swords with blades measuring over one meter. In their "blade" form, Black Keys are thick and oddly-balanced, being heavier towards the tip.

While on the surface they look and function like blades, they're actually prayers: Sacraments of the Holy Church, created with the lament for the dead; litanies, as their base. This makes them equivalent to instant and portable exorcisms, allowing for quick disposal of undead, vampires, ghosts, or anything considered "paranormal".

With lower effectiveness as swords despite their appearance, and their great length, their most effective usage is exclusively as throwing weapons rather than for swordplay. Those who wield them often hold multiple Black Keys at once in a "fan formation" between the fingers of each hand, and an expert can wield up to four in one hand. They can be thrown singularly or all at once with great accuracy and speed, either directly like arrows or throwing them in a spinning arc to curve towards their target like a boomerang

entries.name: Gae Bolg II
secondary_keys: Fake Barbed Spear That Pierces with Death
Fake Soaring Spear That Strikes with Death
entries.content:
Gae Bolg II: A 'C+++' rank, modified copy of the Conceptual Object and Noble Phantasm Gae Bolg. It is a scarlet, cursed spear with an ominous and modified with Reinforcement Magecraft so it can be be fired from a bow. This Fake Noble Phantasm can only be created with Projection and Reinforcement Magecraft, as it does not technically exist.

Fake Barbed Spear That Pierces with Death: When the copied and modified spear's title is spoken and an attack is focused on a single target, the modified spear rewrites the cause and effect of the attack- inverting the order of events; piercing the target’s heart first and determining the method and means second. This attack can be dodged, but doing so requires incredible luck, supernatural reflexes, or precognition/clairvoyance.

Fake Soaring Spear That Strikes with Death: When this technique's name is spoken and the copied and modified spear is fired high into the air, it's spearhead will split from one into numerous and strike the ground in a large area with explosive force.

entries.name: Gae Dearg II
entries.content:
Gae Dearg II: A 'C+++' rank, modified copy of the Noble Phantasm Gae Dearg. It is a demonic, scarlet spear modified with Reinforcement Magecraft so it can be be fired from a bow. This Fake Noble Phantasm can only be created with Projection and Reinforcement Magecraft, as it does not technically exist.

Fake Red Rose of Exorcism/Fake Crimson Rose of Exorcism: When the spear's title is spoken it renders magical enhancements useless and instantly destroys anything made with Projection Magecraft by severing all ties with Magical Energy when coming into contact with them. The spear will pierce directly through any Projection and will render magical enhancements and ability boosts useless; and any item that acts as a Magical Energy source will have all its recipients connections severed.

entries.name: Gae Buidhe II
entries.content:
Gae Buidhe II: A modified copy of the Noble Phantasm Gae Buidhe. It is a cursed, yellow spear modified with Reinforcement Magecraft so it can be be fired from a bow. This Fake Noble Phantasm can only be created with Projection and Reinforcement Magecraft, as it does not technically exist.

Fake Yellow Rose of Mortality/Fake Golden Rose of Mortality: When the spear's title is spoken any wounds inflicted by the spear cannot be healed naturally or with magecraft. The spear lowers the opponent's maximum health limit, thus limiting healing and regeneration abilities to the point where the opponent received the injury. The effect cannot be normally dispelled, and canceling the curse requires the destruction of the spear or the death of its owner.

entries.name: Noble Phantasm
entries.content:
Fake Noble Phantasms: Copies of Noble Phantasms made with Projection Magecraft. Fake Noble Phantasms are a rank below the original and therefor weaker

Noble Phantasms: Magical armaments created from human imagination as their core, and are the weapons and/or abilities owned by Heroic Spirits. As humanity's illusions, they embody the ultimate Mysteries of a hero as symbols of their existence through historical fact and anecdotes.

Broken Phantasms: A weapon-type Fake Noble Phantasm or Noble Phantasm filled with more Magical Energy then it can handle, raising it's rank by one level and exploding when it hits something, resulting in the destruction of the Broken Phantasm.

Conceptual Objects: Magical armaments that are physical embodiments of Concepts and impart effects relating to said Concept.

Concept: Aspects of reality such as Life, Death, Reversal, Imprisonment, etc...

Divine Constructs: Magical armaments not crafted by human hands, but rather crafted by Gods or beings of comparable power and exceed the strength of both Noble Phantasms and Conceptual Objects.

Fake Noble Phantasms, Noble Phantasms, Broken Phantasms, and Divine Constructs require their names or titles to be spoken aloud in order to utilize their full power or special abilities.

Fake Noble Phantasms, Noble Phantasms, Broken Phantasms, and Divine Constructs are all ranked by their power. I order from weakest to strongest, these ranks are: E, E+, E++, E+++, D, D+, D++, D+++, C, C+, C++, C+++, B, B+, B++, B+++, A, A+, A++, A+++, EX, EX+, EX++, and EX+++

entries.name: Heroic Spirit
entries.content:
Also referred to as Servants when they are summoned, Heroic Spirits are the spirits of heroes who achieved great deeds in life, having become objects of reverence or even worship after their deaths. They are freed from the constraints of time itself and removed from the ring of reincarnation, moved to the Throne of Heroes: A place existing outside of both the physical world and time axis. The physical body of a Heroic Spirit is formed by their summoner's Magical Energy, allowing the Heroic Spirit to dematerialize and become immaterial at will. 

Heroic Spirits are placed into one of various Servant Classes. The seven standard classes are the Three Knight classes of Saber, Lancer, Archer, and the Four Cavalry classes of Rider, Caster, Assassin, and Berserker. There is also the non-standard extra Servant Class of Shielder. Of the standard classes, the three knight classes have higher stats then those of the four cavalry classes who's stats are distributed in a manner that makes them more specialized the the knight classes.

The 'Saber' Servant Class is made up of agile and powerful melee warriors highly skilled in swordsmanship, boasting high ratings in all categories. The Saber Class possesses the Magic Resistance and Riding skills.

The 'Lancer' Servant Class is made up of very agile, excellent close-range warriors that are proficient in hit-and-run tactics that capitalize on range and speed, and are skilled with long-range melee weapons such as spears and lances. The Lancer Class possesses the Magic Resistance skill.

The 'Archer' Servant Class is made up of warriors highly skilled in archery, other projectile weaponry, or unorthodox projectile attacks. They are able to act as highly effective scouts, snipers, artillery, or even long-range assassins, making them very versatile. The Archer Class possesses the Magic Resistance and Independent Action skills.

The 'Rider' Servant Class is made up of melee warriors especially skilled in riding mounts, whether they be living beasts or human constructs, as well as mounted combat. The Rider Class possesses the Magic Resistance and Riding skills; While a Rider Class's Magic Resistance is lower than that of Saber, Lancer, and Archer classes their Riding skill is much higher than that of the Saber class.

The 'Caster' Servant Class is made up of highly skilled Mages, and the only qualifying condition is the mastery of sorceries of the highest caliber compared to the specific parameter requirements of the other classes. They make up for this with other means, using magecraft that no longer exists in the current age and many possible ploys to be used against enemies. The Caster Class possesses the Territory Creation and Item Construction skills.

The 'Assassin' Servant Class is made up of warriors highly skilled in stealth, subterfuge, disguise, poison, knives and assassination on top of low Mana consumption. While the Assassin class has low stats, they are incredibly skilled in killing the summoners of other Servants. The Assassin Class possesses the Presence Concealment skill.

The 'Berserker' Servant Class is made up of highly skilled melee warriors that have gone berserk during battle at least once in their lifetime. Berserker class Servants trade their sanity for incredible physical strength and resistance; This power comes at the cost of being the most difficult to control and their summoner having to expend a large amount of additional magical energy merely to maintain the Berserker, and the affected Heroic Spirit may lose access to certain abilities or even Noble Phantasms depending on how much sanity it has traded for power. The Berserker Class possess the Mad Enhancement skill.

The 'Shielder' Servant Class is exclusive to the Heroic Spirit Galahad, a saintly Knight of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s Round Table of Camelot and by extension, Mash Kyrielight's Demi-Servant state. Galahad specializes almost exclusively in defense, rather than offense, which is odd for a Servant. Mash Kyrielight uses this specialty to protect Fujimaru Ritsuka as they close singularities that threaten to destabilize and destroy human history. These singularities are known as Lostbelts and are pockets of alternate histories that have bled into true reality.

Magic Resistance: A skill that grants protection against magical effects.

Riding: A skill that denotes a Heroic Spirit's ability to ride mounts and vehicles.

Independent Action: An ability that allows a Heroic Spirit to stay summoned for a brief time if cut off from their summoner's Magical Energy.

Territory Creation: A skill that allows a Heroic Spirit to build a special terrain that is advantageous to oneself as a magus, such as for the purpose of collecting mana, create magic objects, or perform other tasks. Territories can look different depending on the Servant, as each has their own purpose in mind for the territory they create.

Item Construction: A skill that allows a Heroic Spirit to manufacture magical items, from implements of war to items for daily use. This skill requires gathering components and manufacturing items.

Presence Concealment: A skill that allows a Heroic Spirit to hide their presence, rendering them almost entirely undetectable until the skill is disabled or the user launches an attack.

Mad Enhancement: A skill that raises the stats of a Heroic Spirit's physical abilities at the cost of their sanity.

entries.name: Balmung
entries.content:
Balmung: An 'A+' rank Noble Phantasm belonging to Siegfried, a tragic Dutch hero of German legend. It is a two-handed greatsword adorned with a silver crosses on either side of the shaped metal plate joining the handle and blade, as well as silver inlays on it's crossguard and handle; A magnificent blue jewel is also embedded in the hilt. Balmung is the holy sword of the Nibelung clan used by Siegfried to slay the dragon Fafnir. Upon being bathed in Fafnir's blood along with Siegfried, Balmung took on demonic attributes in addition to it's innate holiness, causing the sword to become either holy or demonic, depending on the wielder's personality. Having accomplished the feat of dragon slaying, Balmung will deal additional damage those with the blood of dragons. 

Feller of the Sky Demon: When the wielder chants "O sword, let thee be filled" and raises it above their head the blue jewel will amass magical energy and channels it into the blade, causing a wave of destructive energy resembling azure flames to surge from the blade when the sword is swung downwards.

entries.name: Projection Magecraft
entries.content: A simple, yet versatile magecraft that shapes Magical Energy into the material composition and design of an object that is being imagined by the caster. While projection can copy Noble Phantasms and Conceptual Objects, the copies are a rank below the original and therefor weaker.

entries.name: Magical Energy
entries.content:
Natural energy found within both the physical world and Magi.

Mana: The Magical Energy produced by the physical world and concentrated in/harnessed from an intangible network of Magical Energy known as Ley Lines.
Od: The Magical Energy produced by all living things. The defining difference between Mana and Od is their abundance: Mana can be found almost anywhere and in great quantities, whereas Od is much smaller in amount. 

Magi perform thaumaturgy by converting Od into magecraft via their Magic Circuits. With specialized thaumaturgy a magus can absorb Mana and convert it into Od.

entries.name: Magic Circuits
entries.content: Magic Circuits are an intangible pseudo-nervous system that spreads itself through the human body and what qualifies a person to be a thaumaturgist. The more Magic Circuits a person has, the more Od they have. The higher quality a Mage's Magic Circuits are, the more powerful their Magecraft is.

entries.name: Thaumaturgists
entries.content:
Thaumaturgist/Thaumaturgists: Practitioners of Thaumaturgy.
Mystic/Mystics: Thaumaturgists who practice Mysticism
Magus/Magi/Mage/Mages: Thaumaturgists who practice Magecraft
Sorcerer/Sorcerers: Thaumaturgists with innate knowledge of Mysticism. Sorcerers have either Divine, Demonic, or Fairy blood.
Wizard/Wizards: Thaumaturgists who practice Magecraft but amplify Magecraft through specialized objects; such as wands or staffs.
Witch/Witches: Thaumaturgists that practice Witchcraft.
Enchanter/Enchanters: Thaumaturgists that practice Enchanting.
Alchemist/Alchemists: Thaumaturgists that practice Alchemy.

entries.name: Thaumaturgy
entries.content:
Thaumaturgy: The catch-all term for magic usage.
Mysticism: Magic derived directly from Mana rather than Od.
Magecraft: Magic derived from Od rather than directly from Mana.
Sorcery: Mysticism that is innate and does not need to be learned.
Wizardry: Thaumaturgy that amplifies Magecraft through specialized objects; such as wands or staffs.
Witchcraft: A special kind of Mysticism that exclusively utilizes curses, hexes, bewitching, and possession.
Enchanting: Thaumaturgy that imbues objects with Magical Energy for specific uses; such as charms and talismans for protection against thaumaturgy or weapons that harness the elements.
Alchemy: Thaumaturgy that changes or transforms something with Magical Energy; such as transmuting lead into gold or amplifying tonics into potions.

entries.name: Tracing Magecraft
entries.content: A simple, yet versatile magecraft that uses Magical Energy to analyze the shape, substance, material composition and design of an object.

entries.name: Reinforcement Magecraft
entries.content: An incredibly difficult Magecraft with the purpose of pushing a basis to the utmost limit. Success requires a good grasp of the inner structure to fill openings with Magical Energy. Reinforcing the purpose of existence would be increasing the sharpness of a knife, the nourishment of food, or in the case of a living creature, physical strength and durability. It is impossible to reinforce something vague. As living things will resist invasion of Magical Energy, reinforcing someone else is the hardest.

entries.name: Rho Aias
secondary_keys: The Seven Rings that Cover the Burning Heavens
entries.content: Rho Aias: Originally the shield used by Aias the Great, the hero who fought along side Achilles in the Trojan War. It was a bronze shield covered in seven layers of oxhide. It became a Conceptual Object when Aias was immortalized in Greek Mythology. As a Conceptual Object it takes the form of a seven flower petals made from light, but it is actually a seven layered Bounded Field in the shape of an iridescent flower. With the seven petals representing the seven layers of oxhide of the original shield. Each flower petal layer has the defensive power of a fortress wall and is said to be an absolute defense against any thrown weapon.

entries.name: Azrael II
entries.content:
Azrael II: A modified copy of the Noble Phantasm Azrael. It is a narrow-bladed sword with no crossguard, modified with Reinforcement Magecraft so it can be be fired from a bow. This Fake Noble Phantasm can only be created with Projection and Reinforcement Magecraft, as it does not technically exist.

Fake Angel That Announces Death: When the sword's title is spoken, Azrael II inexplicably causes the target's instantaneous and medically inexplicable death on impact, even if the blade does not wound them.

entries.name: Gae Dearg
entries.content:
Gae Dearg: A 'B' rank Noble Phantasm belonging to Diarmuid Ua Duibhne, a proud and noble knight of Celtic (Irish) history. It is a demonic, scarlet spear two meters long.

Red Rose of Exorcism/Crimson Rose of Exorcism: When the spear's title is spoken it renders magical enhancements useless and instantly destroys anything made with Projection Magecraft by severing all ties with Magical Energy when coming into contact with them. The spear will pierce directly through any Projection and will render magical enhancements and ability boosts useless; and any item that acts as a Magical Energy source will have all its recipients connections severed.

entries.name: Gae Buidhe
entries.content:
Gae Buidhe: A 'B' rank Noble Phantasm belonging to Diarmuid Ua Duibhne, a proud and noble knight of Celtic (Irish) history. It is a cursed, yellow spear 1.4 meters long.

Yellow Rose of Mortality/Golden Rose of Mortality: When the spear's title is spoken any wounds inflicted by the spear cannot be healed naturally or with magecraft. The spear lowers the opponent's maximum health limit, thus limiting healing and regeneration abilities to the point where the opponent received the injury. The effect cannot be normally dispelled, and canceling the curse requires the destruction of the spear or the death of its owner.

entries.name: Gae Bolg
secondary_keys: Barbed Spear That Pierces with Death
Soaring Spear That Strikes with Death
entries.content:
Gae Bolg: A 'B' rank Noble Phantasm belonging to Cu Chulainn, a hero of Celtic (Irish) mythology. It is a scarlet, cursed spear with an ominous design: It's shaft wrapped with raised inlays that resemble brambles and it's spearhead serrated near the base. If thrown and striking a target, Gae Bolg with return to it's wielder.

Barbed Spear That Pierces with Death: A 'B' rank Anti-Unit attack. This technique is activated by calling out the spear's and technique's names. When used, the technique rewrites the cause and effect of the attack: inverting the order of events and working backwards from the piercing of the target’s heart then determining the method and means of doing so afterwards. This attack can be dodged, but doing so requires incredible luck, supernatural reflexes, or precognition/clairvoyance. This technique consumes very little Magical Energy.

Soaring Spear That Strikes with Death: A 'B+' rank Anti-Army attack. This technique is activated by calling out the spear's and technique's names. Performing this attack requires the user to throw the spear from high above the target when the technique is active, doing so will cause the spearhead will split from one into numerous and strike the ground in a large area with explosive force.

entries.name: Excalibur
entries.content:
Excalibur: An 'A++' rank and incredibly powerful Noble Phantasm and Divine Construct belonging to King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon). It is the legendary and majestic holy sword of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon). This sword is the pinnacle of holy swords and the strongest holy sword to ever exist. Excalibur is a longsword with a length of ninety centimeters and a width of twelve centimeters, and it has an unknown phrase inscribed in the language of Fairies on it's blade.

Sword of Promised Victory: When the wielder chants "This light is the hope of those who have fallen. Proof of their sacrifice for righteousness. Behold: Excalibur." and raises it above their head the sword amasses Magical Energy and channels it into the blade, causing an immense, linear blast of destructive energy resembling golden light to fire from the blade when the sword is swung downwards.

entries.name: Clarent
entries.content:
Clarent: A 'B' rank and powerful Noble Phantasm originally belonging to King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon) and later being wielded by Mordred Pendragon, daughter of King Arthur and Morgan le Fay. It is an ornate, silver longsword adorned with splendid decorations, acting as a symbol of kingship denoting the right of succession of the throne of Britain. It is a treasured sword that has worth and strength equal to, if not exceeding, Caliburn, that amplifies the authority of the king.

Clarent Blood Arthur: When the wielder chants "I am no king, but I follow in the king's path. I will destroy all that I must to bring the king peace. Clarent Blood Arthur." and raises it above their head the sword amasses Magical Energy and channels it into the blade, causing a line of destructive energy resembling crimson lightning to extend from the blade when the sword is swung downwards.

entries.name: Caliburn
entries.content:
Caliburn: A 'B' rank and powerful Noble Phantasm belonging to King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon), the legendary King of Britain. The holy sword that is the symbol of the king pulled from the stone of appointment by King Arthur (Artoria Pendragon) under the guidance of the wizard Merlin. With the words "Whosoe'er pulleth out this sword of this stone is rightwise king of all England" engraved in a golden inscription on its hilt, it became the symbol of England's King of Knights once it was pulled from the stone. It is a dazzling longsword, adorned with much gold.

Golden Sword of the Victorious: When the wielder chants "Sword of Selection, grant me your power. Cleave the wicked. Caliburn." and raises it above their head the sword amasses Magical Energy and channels it into the blade, causing a linear blast of destructive energy resembling golden light to fire from the blade when the sword is swung downwards.

entries.name: Reality Marble
entries.content: A unique kind of Bounded Field that temporarily materializes and projects the user's inner reality onto true reality. The worlds of Reality Marbles are completely cut off from true reality, projecting their internal landscape and sealing off true reality. True reality constantly attempts to crush the unnatural Bounded Fields as they are not created by spiritual beings, meaning that it costs a great deal of Magical Energy to construct one and keep it stabilized. This generally only allows them to be used for a few minutes.

entries.name: Crocea Mors
entries.content:
Crocea Mors: A 'B+' rank and incredibly powerful Noble Phantasm belonging to Gaius Julius Caesar. It is short, golden sword with a cross-shaped hilt and guard, decorated with blue symbols. Said hilt is also blue and possesses a spherical jewel at the bottom.

The Yellow Death: When the wielder chants "I came. I saw. Now I will conquer." Crocea Mors inexplicably ensures victory.

entries.name: Avalon
entries.content: Avalon: An 'EX' rank Noble Phantasm and Conceptual Object and the hallowed scabbard of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s Excalibur. It is a luxurious piece of equipment made of gold and decorated with blue enamel that seems more like a treasure to show dignity and nobility like a crown or staff than a weapon. It was created by fairies along with Excalibur, an unknown phrase is engraved in the language of Fairies on its center to show that it is not the work of man. It bequeaths limited immortality through constant and potent healing, as well as preventing physical deterioration caused by aging.

entries.name: Kanshou & Bakuya
entries.content:
Kanshou & Bakuya: An 'A' rank Noble Phantasm. A pair "married", curved, and single-edged short swords known as the Twin-Linked Crane Wings. These swords were crafted more for the sake of crafting, as if questioning the meaning of the swordsmith, than for any real idea behind their creation. They were created without vanity, and lack a sense of purpose found in other swords. They contain no fighting spirit to defeat others nor a competitive spirit to beat other weapons, and they contain neither the desire to be famous nor the faith to accomplish great deeds. They are identical in shape with the only difference being their color: The blade of Kanshou is matte black and covered in a large, red hexagonal pattern. While the blade of Bakuya has a glossy white finish that reflects light splendidly. These weapons were forged with a human sacrifice, elevating them from simple blades to weapons fit for gods. If one of these swords are thrown while the other is held, the thrown sword will return; spinning like a boomerang. This returning property also applies to Projected copies.

Overedge: A technique that uses reinforcement magic to lengthen and widen the blades of Kanshou and Bakuya.
Triple-Linked Crane Wings: A technique in which the user projects three sets of Kanshou and Bakuya. Beginning with a pair thrown at the enemy with the purpose of being deflected, followed by closing in for close combat with a second pair. While the enemy is off guard, the user slashes with the second pair, and the thrown pair returns and hits the enemy from behind. Finally, the third pair is modified into Overedge and the user performs the final strike with them. The only ways to defeat this technique are with an omni-directional defense, or by ignoring the damage to make a suicidal assault on the user.

entries.name: Enkidu
entries.content: Enkidu: A 'EX' rank Noble Phantasm and Divine Construct belonging to Gilgamesh, a Mesopotamian demigod and first king of humanity. It is an impossible, infinite, and divine chain. Originally belonging to it's eponymous owner and later owned by Gilgamesh. Enkidu has no limit to it's length and an impossible amount of ends. It can be stored within it's wielder's soul, allowing it's bladed ends to manifest and launch from anywhere on the wielder's body. The more divine a target is, the more painful the chain's binding. Neither Enkidu nor it's binding can be broken or loosened by anyone other than the wielder. Enkidu's chains can bind anything, physical or otherwise.

entries.name: Caladbolg II
entries.content:
Caladbolg II: A 'A' rank, modified copy of the Noble Phantasm Caladbolg. It is a spiral sword with a drill-shaped blade modified with Reinforcement Magecraft so it can be be fired from a bow. This Fake Noble Phantasm can only be created with Projection and Reinforcement Magecraft, as it does not technically exist.

Fake Spiral Sword: When the sword's title is spoken the blade of the sword coils into a narrow spiral that travels through anything in it's path by creating a twisting distortion in space until it hits it's target.

entries.name: Hrunting II
secondary_keys: Fake Hound of the Red Plains
entries.content:
Hrunting II: A 'B+++' rank, modified copy of the Noble Phantasm Hrunting. It is a pitch-black spike with a few small edges coiling around the thin core, spiraling around it and somewhat curving outward. It has been modified with Reinforcement Magecraft so it can be be fired from a bow. This Fake Noble Phantasm can only be created with Projection and Reinforcement Magecraft, as it does not technically exist.

Fake Hound of the Red Plains: When sword's title is spoken and fired from a bow, it will autonomously and continuously attempt to hit the target even if it is parried, repulsed, or avoided without losing momentum. Hrunting II will continue it's assault until it hits its target or the weapon is destroyed.

entries.name: Bounded Field
entries.content: A geographical form of Magecraft whereby one knits a boundary line of Magical Energy around a space to separate its inside from the outside, cutting off and isolating that space from the outside world and then imposing an effect on the inside or the boundary line itself.

entries.name: Lord Camelot
secondary_keys: Now is a Castle of Distant Ideals
entries.content:
Lord Camelot: A 'B+++' rank, incredibly powerful and potentially indestructible Noble Phantasm and Conceptual Object belonging to Galahad, a saintly Knight of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s Round Table of Camelot. It is a large, round shield with an additional cross-shaped plate mounted to the face of the shield. The ends of the plate are indented and sharped. It was made from King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s Round Table of Camelot and can potentially become the ultimate defense.

Now is a Castle of Distant Ideals: When the shield's title is spoken a phantasmal recreation of the outer walls of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s castle, Camelot. These phantasmal castle walls protect whoever the wielder of Lord Camelot allows in. The strength and protection of these illusory walls depends on the wielder's willpower.

entries.name: Azrael
entries.content:
Azrael: A 'C' rank, but incredibly powerful Noble Phantasm and Conceptual Object belonging to the first Hassan-i-Sabbah, the first assassin in human history and founder of the Hashashin order of assassins. Azrael is a large, broad-bladed, sword with no crossguard and is seemingly made of blackened iron.

The Angel That Announces Death: Upon the wielder chanting "Hearken. The evening bell tolls thy name. Wings of death, will thou sever their head? Azrael." When the chant is completed and the sword's title is spoken, Azrael causes the target's instantaneous and medically inexplicable death upon touch, even if the blade does not wound them.

entries.name: Unlimited Blade Works
secondary_keys: I am the bone of my sword. Steel is my body and fire is my blood. I have created over a thousand blades. Unknown to Death
Nor known to Life. I have withstood pain to create many weapons. Yet
those hands will never hold anything. So as I pray
entries.content: Unlimited Blade Works: The Noble Phantasm of EMIYA. While it is not a true Noble Phantasm, a Noble Phantasm is defined as a symbol of the Heroic Spirit, then Unlimited Blade Works is EMIYA's Noble Phantasm. It manifests as a hill surrounded by an open, barren desert and monolithic black gears gyrating in the distance. It is a kingdom of rubble littered with thousands, perhaps a countless number, of swords anchored in the ground like grave markers in a wasteland, yet are all well preserved. It is a world likened to a steel mill, filled with weapons, flames, and giant gears. It is the final illusion EMIYA saw on the verge of death, the only pride left within himself. Unlimited Blade Works also acts a database for every weapon EMIYA has ever seen, allowing him to use Projection Magecraft and conjure a Projected copy of any weapon he's seen. Activating Unlimited Blade Works requires EMIYA to chant "I am the bone of my sword. Steel is my body and fire is my blood. I have created over a thousand blades. Unknown to Death, Nor known to Life. I have withstood pain to create many weapons. Yet, those hands will never hold anything. So as I pray, Unlimited Blade Works.". The lines of the incantation can be said at any time without requiring preparation, and EMIYA is able to stop between lines to speak and then resume without issue. The first line is also often used in order to strengthen a Projection. Once the incantations has been completed, an illusionary fire that does not emit any heat spreads out to form a boundary and wall for the Bounded Field. The bright light fills the vision of those present, and EMIYA's inner reality manifests.

entries.name: Gate of Babylon
entries.content: Gate of Babylon: Gate of Babylon is the Noble Phantasm of Gilgamesh. It is the gateway to his treasury, connecting the space of reality to the vault and opening an invisible door between dimensions that allows for the contents to pass through upon their owner's command. The items passing through the gate form gold-glowing energy ripples in the empty air as they appear instantly. Gilgamesh can summon items directly into his hand, pull out weapons from directly behind him, or prepare numerous weapons midair, loaded like bullets. Gilgamesh's treasury contains all the treasures in the world: a perfect treasury that lacks literally nothing. As anything can be found within the vault, the amount of wealth within exceeds even his own knowledge. The most used contents of this treasury are the originals of nearly all weapon-type Noble Phantasms: While these Noble Phantasms are prototypes of the ones that came later, they are no less powerful. Gilgamesh can recall anything brought out of the Gate of Babylon with a thought, the item vanishing into golden particles and returning to his treasury.

entries.name: Time Manipulation Magecraft
entries.content:
Time Manipulation: Magecraft that controls the flow of time. It is the ability to separate the passage of time inside a designated space from the "flow of time" in the outside world. It is a Magecraft in the form of a Bounded Field that can be regarded as a type of Reality Marble in a way, but still not something extraordinarily difficult to utilize like other time related Magecraft. It allows for adjusting time and can only stagnate the time which has passed and accelerate time in the future and cannot reverse cause and effect to change the past.
Time Alteration: A specialized form of Time Manipulation that limits the Bounded Field and it's effect to the user's body. Even this minimalistic approach to Time Manipulation, it is still a Magecraft far above the level of basic physical enchantment that causes inconsistencies between the flow of time inside and outside the field. Once the Time Alteration is complete and the Bounded Field is removed, True Reality will forcefully adjust the incorrect time. This places a large burden on the user with each use, as the Bounded Field where the "errors have occurred" is within their own physical body. In order to get back in sync with the normal time flow, adjustments occur within the user's flesh, greatly damaging them.
Time Alter: Accel is a Time Alteration technique that increases the user's blood flow, hemoglobin metabolism, and muscle movement all at the same time. Using this brief burst of speed, the user can use their own physical skills and reaction speed at a level far above human limitations. It allows for split second evasion in front of an enemy, and its power of mobility can make for one of the greatest defenses.
Time Alter: Stagnate is a Time Alteration technique that slow the user's biological processes by slowing their heartbeat, slowing their breathing, and reducing their metabolism to the point where body temperature cools.

entries.name: Reality
entries.content:
True Reality: The physical world that abides by the laws of nature and the single most powerful force in existence.
Inner Reality: An individual's mental landscape. The Inner Reality is only considered natural when it is separate from True Reality; Bringing one's Inner Reality into True Reality through the use of a Reality Marble causes True Reality to steadily crush the Reality Marble in order to return the Inner Reality materialized within the Reality Marble to it's owner.

entries.name: Ea
secondary_keys: The Star of Creation That Split Heaven and Earth
entries.content:
Ea: An 'EX+' rank, immeasurably powerful Noble Phantasm and Divine Construct possessed only by Gilgamesh, a Mesopotamian demigod and first king of humanity. It has an abnormal shape that doesn't match what would normally be classified as a sword. It is something that was born before the concept of a sword, so it is not something that can truly be called a sword or have the shape of a blade. While it has a grip, handguard, and is the same length as a longsword, the section that should contain a blade deviates from the normal form of an edged weapon. The "blade" itself and the tip of the sword, spun in a spiral shape, are dull. It has the shape of a cylindrical, drill-shaped pillar made up of three independently rotating segments engraved with glowing crimson cuneiform lettering that spin slowly in an alternating direction, the middle segment spinning clockwise and the top and bottom segments spinning counterclockwise. Its three sections respectively represent the heavens, the earth, and the underworld. It exemplifies the world's way of being by having each one of them rotate in opposite directions. The "cosmos" is thus represented by matching all three of these representations. Everything together represents the universe. It is the primordial sword that is the actualization of the works of a god recorded before humanity came into being, and it is that which divided the formless into the distinct heaven, earth and the underworld. When Ea's power is unleashed, it's segments rotate fast enough to draw wind into the sword. This wind is inexplicably compressed and intertwined to become a dislocation of space-time that is represented as something akin to either a torrent or whirlwind. This attack opens an abyss capable of crushing anything. The center of the storm is not calm, but rather a hole to Hell itself that returns all that enters its realm to the nothingness from which it originated. The wind pressure creates a vacuum that takes all things with form, the land, the atmosphere, and the sky, into the whirling void. The tumult of genesis takes everything that was nothing more than chaos, which could not form any meaning, and creates a new truth that divides and distinguishes Heaven, Sea, and Earth. Within the darkness where everything is returned to nothingness, only Ea is left

Ea cannot be copied by Projection Magecraft.

The Star of Creation That Split Heaven and Earth: A technique that releases Ea's maximum output. Depending on the seriousness behind the attack, Ea could potentially destroy all of existence. Activating Ea's full power requires the user to recite one of several incantations: "I will tell you of the beginning: Heaven and Earth split, nothingness congratulated creation, my Sword of Rupture cleaved the world. Mortar of the Stars, Heaven's Hell is the eve of Creation's celebration. Now you shall die and be silent: Enuma Elish.", "Judgment is upon you. Behold the crushing might of my Sword of Rupture: Enuma Elish.", "The elements coalesce and solidify to bring forth the star where creation interweaves. In death, you will bow before it: Enuma Elish.", "I speak of genesis: The elements amalgamate, coalesce, and bring forth the star that weaves all of creation. Pay homage in death: Enuma Elish.", "It is Time. Awaken, Ea. Know the law of Heaven. Worship me and Die: Enuma Elish.", "Ea, Sing praise as you like. I will tell you of the beginning: Heaven and Earth split. Nothingness congratulated Creation... and my Sword of Rupture cleaved the world. Mortar of the Stars, Heaven's Hell is the eve of Creation's celebration: Enuma Elish.". Any of these incantations can be paused and resumed as long as Ea is wielded.

entries.name: Excalibur Galatine (WIP)
entries.content:
Excalibur Galatine: An 'A+' rank, incredibly powerful Noble Phantasm and Divine Construct belonging Gawain, the most loyal and honorable knight of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s Round table. It is the sister sword of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s own Excalibur and is a representation of the sun itself.

Sword of Revolving Victory: A technique in which Excalibur Galatine is thrown high into the air and the pseudo sun within it creates a miniature sun before returning to the wielder's hand. While this pseudo sun floats overhead a large magic circle with a sun symbol in the center appears under the wielder. With a motion like drawing a sword, the wielder unleashes a horizontal slash of flame that pierces through the enemy and erupts into a giant ball of fire that engulfs them. This attack has a range of about 8.1 miles (13 kilometers).

entries.name: Arondight (WIP)
secondary_keys: The Unfading Light of the Lake
entries.content:
Arondight: An 'A' rank and incredibly powerful Noble Phantasm belonging to Lancelot du Lac; One of the greatest knights of King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s Round table. It is a holy sword that mirrors and rivals King Arthur Pendragon (Artoria Pendragon)'s own Excalibur.

Arondight Overload: A technique in which Arondight is glows with the light of the holy light of the Lake from which it, Excalibur and Excalibur Galatine originated. With Arondight overcharged with this holy light the next slash from the sword will leave a glowing gash of said holy light on the target that soon after detonates in a blast of Magical Energy.

Arondight can also launch medium-sized 'waves' of its holy light as projectiles.

entries.name: Black Key
entries.content:
Holy scripture converted into weaponized charms through a holy Magecraft unique to the Holy Church. The base form of a Black Key is a small, crimson, T-shaped charm. When a wielder channels their Magical Energy into a Black Key, they take the form of long and slender rapier-like swords with blades measuring over one meter. In their "blade" form, Black Keys are thick and oddly-balanced, being heavier towards the tip.

While on the surface they look and function like blades, they're actually prayers: Sacraments of the Holy Church, created with the lament for the dead; litanies, as their base. This makes them equivalent to instant and portable exorcisms, allowing for quick disposal of undead, vampires, ghosts, or anything considered "paranormal".

With lower effectiveness as swords despite their appearance, and their great length, their most effective usage is exclusively as throwing weapons rather than for swordplay. Those who wield them often hold multiple Black Keys at once in a "fan formation" between the fingers of each hand, and an expert can wield up to four in one hand. They can be thrown singularly or all at once with great accuracy and speed, either directly like arrows or throwing them in a spinning arc to curve towards their target like a boomerang

entries.name: Gae Bolg II
secondary_keys: Fake Barbed Spear That Pierces with Death
Fake Soaring Spear That Strikes with Death
entries.content:
Gae Bolg II: A 'C+++' rank, modified copy of the Conceptual Object and Noble Phantasm Gae Bolg. It is a scarlet, cursed spear with an ominous and modified with Reinforcement Magecraft so it can be be fired from a bow. This Fake Noble Phantasm can only be created with Projection and Reinforcement Magecraft, as it does not technically exist.

Fake Barbed Spear That Pierces with Death: When the copied and modified spear's title is spoken and an attack is focused on a single target, the modified spear rewrites the cause and effect of the attack- inverting the order of events; piercing the target’s heart first and determining the method and means second. This attack can be dodged, but doing so requires incredible luck, supernatural reflexes, or precognition/clairvoyance.

Fake Soaring Spear That Strikes with Death: When this technique's name is spoken and the copied and modified spear is fired high into the air, it's spearhead will split from one into numerous and strike the ground in a large area with explosive force.

entries.name: Gae Dearg II
entries.content:
Gae Dearg II: A 'C+++' rank, modified copy of the Noble Phantasm Gae Dearg. It is a demonic, scarlet spear modified with Reinforcement Magecraft so it can be be fired from a bow. This Fake Noble Phantasm can only be created with Projection and Reinforcement Magecraft, as it does not technically exist.

Fake Red Rose of Exorcism/Fake Crimson Rose of Exorcism: When the spear's title is spoken it renders magical enhancements useless and instantly destroys anything made with Projection Magecraft by severing all ties with Magical Energy when coming into contact with them. The spear will pierce directly through any Projection and will render magical enhancements and ability boosts useless; and any item that acts as a Magical Energy source will have all its recipients connections severed.

entries.name: Gae Buidhe II
entries.content:
Gae Buidhe II: A modified copy of the Noble Phantasm Gae Buidhe. It is a cursed, yellow spear modified with Reinforcement Magecraft so it can be be fired from a bow. This Fake Noble Phantasm can only be created with Projection and Reinforcement Magecraft, as it does not technically exist.

Fake Yellow Rose of Mortality/Fake Golden Rose of Mortality: When the spear's title is spoken any wounds inflicted by the spear cannot be healed naturally or with magecraft. The spear lowers the opponent's maximum health limit, thus limiting healing and regeneration abilities to the point where the opponent received the injury. The effect cannot be normally dispelled, and canceling the curse requires the destruction of the spear or the death of its owner.

entries.name: Noble Phantasm
entries.content:
Fake Noble Phantasms: Copies of Noble Phantasms made with Projection Magecraft. Fake Noble Phantasms are a rank below the original and therefor weaker

Noble Phantasms: Magical armaments created from human imagination as their core, and are the weapons and/or abilities owned by Heroic Spirits. As humanity's illusions, they embody the ultimate Mysteries of a hero as symbols of their existence through historical fact and anecdotes.

Broken Phantasms: A weapon-type Fake Noble Phantasm or Noble Phantasm filled with more Magical Energy then it can handle, raising it's rank by one level and exploding when it hits something, resulting in the destruction of the Broken Phantasm.

Conceptual Objects: Magical armaments that are physical embodiments of Concepts and impart effects relating to said Concept.

Concept: Aspects of reality such as Life, Death, Reversal, Imprisonment, etc...

Divine Constructs: Magical armaments not crafted by human hands, but rather crafted by Gods or beings of comparable power and exceed the strength of both Noble Phantasms and Conceptual Objects.

Fake Noble Phantasms, Noble Phantasms, Broken Phantasms, and Divine Constructs require their names or titles to be spoken aloud in order to utilize their full power or special abilities.

Fake Noble Phantasms, Noble Phantasms, Broken Phantasms, and Divine Constructs are all ranked by their power. I order from weakest to strongest, these ranks are: E, E+, E++, E+++, D, D+, D++, D+++, C, C+, C++, C+++, B, B+, B++, B+++, A, A+, A++, A+++, EX, EX+, EX++, and EX+++

entries.name: Heroic Spirit
entries.content:
Also referred to as Servants when they are summoned, Heroic Spirits are the spirits of heroes who achieved great deeds in life, having become objects of reverence or even worship after their deaths. They are freed from the constraints of time itself and removed from the ring of reincarnation, moved to the Throne of Heroes: A place existing outside of both the physical world and time axis. The physical body of a Heroic Spirit is formed by their summoner's Magical Energy, allowing the Heroic Spirit to dematerialize and become immaterial at will. 

Heroic Spirits are placed into one of various Servant Classes. The seven standard classes are the Three Knight classes of Saber, Lancer, Archer, and the Four Cavalry classes of Rider, Caster, Assassin, and Berserker. There is also the non-standard extra Servant Class of Shielder. Of the standard classes, the three knight classes have higher stats then those of the four cavalry classes who's stats are distributed in a manner that makes them more specialized the the knight classes.

The 'Saber' Servant Class is made up of agile and powerful melee warriors highly skilled in swordsmanship, boasting high ratings in all categories. The Saber Class possesses the Magic Resistance and Riding skills.

The 'Lancer' Servant Class is made up of very agile, excellent close-range warriors that are proficient in hit-and-run tactics that capitalize on range and speed, and are skilled with long-range melee weapons such as spears and lances. The Lancer Class possesses the Magic Resistance skill.

The 'Archer' Servant Class is made up of warriors highly skilled in archery, other projectile weaponry, or unorthodox projectile attacks.
